name: Sub bass
why: A sine wave: the lowest, plainest bass there is. You feel it more than you hear it, so it leaves the whole mix free for everything else.

ingredients.name: A sine wave
ingredients.adds: One pure low tone with no buzz.

ingredients.name: Shape the note
ingredients.adds: Each note fades instead of holding at full level.

knobs.above: Notes run together into a drone.

ingredients.name: A little drive
ingredients.listenFor: On small speakers the bass appears where there was none.

knobs.below: Gone on a phone or laptop.
knobs.above: It stops being a sub and starts to buzz.

ingredients.name: Tidy the top
ingredients.adds: Takes back the highest of the overtones the drive added.

knobs.label: cutoff
knobs.below: The drive is filtered away again.
knobs.above: A fizzy edge on every note.

pitfalls: A sub and a kick on the same step fight for the same space.
